title: Optional AUM service: one administrative authority
subtitle: Merged P55 · independent of Turnstile and outside inference. The service enforces manager scope and write safety; API Management still enforces requests. Client integration is a separate contract.

groups.title: Python Functions Flex Consumption · Entra bearer API
Administrative write boundary · service managed identity

nodes.title: 1 · Assigned people only
lines: Azure CLI pre-authorized for [[access]]
[[roles]]
[[groups]] claims
No Graph application grant, client secret or developer console access.

nodes.title: 2 · Validate and resolve scope on the server
lines: [[api]] uses [[verifier]]: signature, pinned issuer/tenant, audience, expiry, person oid, delegated scope and role.
[[service]] resolves [[scope]] from stored manager mappings and current gateway configuration.
Null scope is unrestricted; an object, including empty lists, is scoped. Overage grants no group scope.
Function authLevel anonymous disables function-key reliance; it does not make the API unauthenticated.

nodes.title: 3 · Refuse a second writer
lines: [[integration]] is checked.
If Turnstile owns governance or budgets, AUM service refuses gateway writes.
Choose one authority; do not disable this guard to connect another UI.

nodes.title: 4 · Audit, lease, write, verify
lines: [[apply]]
Durable audit intent before mutation
Renewed gateway-wide lease, fresh revisions and ARM ETags
Read-back; reverse compensation on failure. Never overwrite a later independent write.

nodes.title: 5 · Keyless service storage
lines: [[store]]
[[table]]: manager maps, requests, boosts, warnings and audit
[[lease]]: writer lease
Blob Data Owner and Table Data Contributor on its own storage; no shared keys.

nodes.title: 6 · Existing APIM named-value contract
lines: Narrow named-value role; no gateway policy or network changes
Canonical serializers, 4,096-character limit, no truncation
Allocation is independent of budget mode; daily overrides reserve 31 days against a monthly parent.

nodes.title: 7 · Requests and expiring boosts
lines: Approval/rejection/escalation recheck scope and headroom.
Self-approval is denied. Explicit admin-only [[override]] needs a reason and audit flag, never bypasses headroom.
Unknown write outcomes require inspection, not automatic retry.

nodes.title: Timers, not always-on loops
lines: [[expire]]: every minute
Compare-and-restore expired boosts; retry overdue records later.
[[warnings]]: every 15 minutes
Idempotent warning records; email delivery is not implemented here.

nodes.title: Bounded Log Analytics reads
lines: Log Analytics Reader on the selected workspace
Existing saved usage functions; server-side scope filters and keyset paging
Projection mode uses observed unambiguous request stamps, not the obsolete membership map.

nodes.title: Explicit deployment choices
lines: Public Entra API or private endpoint
Private-storage choice: VNet integration + Blob/Table endpoints and DNS
[[routing]] for private storage
Zero/one warm instance, storage redundancy and telemetry are priced choices.

nodes.title: Not a model gateway, not PostgreSQL, not a promise of 500,000 per-person overrides.

notice: This diagram describes the merged service contract, not an additional live manager or multi-writer test by the architecture packet. Inference stays at APIM/Foundry; application workflows and their audit history stay in the service's own storage.
